topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I can't believe it. Just when I think I've seen it all, in comes this so-called 'gift'. I wasn't expecting anything, and honestly, I don’t need a reminder of the past. I put in the work, did my best, and now this. A dusty old book, as if that’s going to change anything. Years of dedication, and this is what I get? Worse, the note. It’s condescending, like they’re thanking me for a favor they did themselves. I should be the one handing out thanks, for their attention, for their effort, for everything. Instead, I’m left holding this thing, a weight I didn’t ask for, a reminder of the gratitude that’s really just a facade.
